Hi Anna —

Thanks for the SQ and the clear list. I pulled together short answers below to unblock procurement + security before the call; we’ll bring config examples during the deep dive. If anything below should be expanded into a follow-up doc, let me know and I’ll convert to a separate level-2 artifact.

1) SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (Security & Availability) completed for our hosted platform; we can provide the report under an NDA. For Dedicated/Private deployments we maintain the same control baseline and provide an attestation addendum; Type II for specific on-prem packages can be scoped per contract.

2) Data residency / retention:
- Logs & telemetry: default retention for platform usage metrics is 90 days.
- Configurable retention: for Dedicated and Private customers we expose retention controls per org (30/90/365 days) plus an option to purge on request. For Hosted customers we offer retention controls for enterprise plans via console settings and a support-configurable option.

3) Telemetry & cookies (console + docs):
- Console telemetry: by default we collect aggregated usage metrics (API route, latency buckets, token counts), client-side error telemetry, and optional user-agent/browser metadata for debugging. No raw customer prompts/text are included in console telemetry.
- Docs site: we use a separate analytics container for the docs site; cookie usage there is limited to non-identifying analytics (pageviews, referrer, session duration).
- Cookies: cookies used by the console are session (non-persistent) and a short-lived analytics cookie (30 days) used to correlate session metrics. Docs site cookies are 30-day persistent by default.
- Opt-outs / minimization: customers can enable a strict telemetry mode in both Hosted and Dedicated which disables client-side error telemetry, removes user-agent capture, and converts metrics to anonymized aggregates only. We can also host docs on a customer subdomain or provide a cookie-less docs bundle for procurement-sensitive use cases.

4) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA for Private (customer-managed) deployments where the customer controls the environment; for Hosted we support a limited set of HIPAA features and evaluate BAA requests on a case-by-case basis. We’ll have Stephanie (legal) coordinate specific language.

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (already shared). I’ll prepare a short telemetry + cookie config guide and share before the call (link to Drive).

Proposed call confirmed: Thu 18 Mar 10:30 PT — I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda: 1) telemetry/cookie walkthrough (10 min) 2) SOC2 evidence & NDA process (10 min) 3) BAA/hipaa edge cases (10 min).

—Priyom
